toolsPreview.name: ask
toolsPreview.description: Answer a question by quoting a published wiki article. The answer is extracted verbatim, never generated, and always carries the URL it came from. Returns confident=false with suggested reading when the corpus does not cover the question. Ask in the language you want answered — Russian and English are both first-class.

toolsPreview.name: search
toolsPreview.description: Rank published articles for a query and return them with titles and URLs. Use when you want sources to read rather than a single answer.
